title: X6: Widget snapshots never regenerate on the app's own local writes

description: Registration is on NSPersistentStoreRemoteChange only, which does not fire for same-coordinator saves (a macOS source comment asserts the opposite - it's wrong). The widget is permanently stale in localOnly mode; the 30-minute backstop just re-reads the same stale JSON. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 5, plan 5b widget-snapshot-correctness. Sweep: cross-process.
